intro: A rake, a disposable crystal tray and no app: the Crystal Pro's problems are mechanical and usually visible. Nearly all of them come down to the rake path, the tray or the crystals themselves.

facts.text: Uses only ScoopFree crystal litter in disposable, plastic-lined trays.
A health counter driven by motion sensors shows usage on the unit itself; there is no app.

symptoms.title: The rake stops partway or does not return
symptoms.summary: The rake halts mid-sweep or fails to park.
causes: A large clump or object blocks the rake path.
Crystals are piled into a ridge the rake cannot climb.
The tray is not seated square.

fixes.detail: Remove the obstruction by hand with the power off. Never force the rake while powered.
Smooth the crystal bed by hand every week or two.
Make sure the tray sits flat and square with no lip catching the rake.

symptoms.escalate: If the rake stalls on a clean, level, well-seated tray, contact PetSafe's US-based support.

symptoms.title: The health counter looks wrong
symptoms.summary: The usage count is far too high, too low, or never changes.
causes: The motion sensor counts any movement, not just your cat.
The counter was not reset at the last tray change.

fixes.detail: Wipe the sensor window with a dry cloth.
Other pets or a robot vacuum passing the opening will add to the count.
Clear the counter when fitting a new tray so the figure means something.

symptoms.escalate: A counter that never moves despite confirmed use has a sensor fault.

symptoms.title: Smell rises late in a tray's life
symptoms.summary: The box smells fine at first, then worse as a tray ages.
causes: The crystals are saturated and absorbing less.
Solid waste is sitting in the compartment too long.

fixes.detail: Tray life varies with your cat; a larger cat or extra use exhausts it early.
Mixing the bed weekly exposes fresh crystals.
Clear solids from the covered end separately from changing the tray.

symptoms.escalate: Persistent ammonia smell on a fresh tray may be a health signal worth raising with a vet.
